native_model_policy: BeerJSON hop inventory is contextual stock state. When amount is present and the containing hop variety can be represented as a referenceable native material, import it as a separate inventory position referencing that material. Do not add inventory fields to the hop material itself and do not invent a material lot because BeerJSON supplies no lot identity.
context_requirements: A native inventory position requires a material_reference supplied by the containing imported hop material/variety context.
If the containing BeerJSON hop cannot receive a referenceable native material representation, preserve HopInventoryType as source data rather than inventing a dangling native inventory record.

field_mappings.reverse: Reconstruct the BeerJSON amount from the retained reported value and BeerJSON unit token; do not use the canonical value when an unchanged reported representation is available.

empty_object_policy: BeerJSON HopInventoryType does not require amount. An empty source object remains valid BeerJSON source data but does not create a native inventory position because FermentationJSON inventoryPosition requires a material reference and quantity.
lot_policy: Do not create a native materialLot from HopInventoryType. BeerJSON HopInventoryType contains no lot identifier, supplier lot, receipt date, or other lot identity.
non_inferences: Do not treat BeerJSON inventory as intrinsic hop-variety identity.
Do not infer a material lot from inventory amount alone.
Do not infer inventory location, timestamp, supplier, availability status, or storage conditions.
Do not convert an empty BeerJSON inventory object into zero inventory.
